[quote=united_hydronia;59567706]The Hydronian soldiers seemed more relaxed now. All guns had been lowered and any sense of hostility had dissipated.
[i]Nice to meet you. Alkiragunya huh, Ive heard that name before old stories in Hydronia, dating back to the colonial period when we held many territories in Argos. The stories say that the reason we were never able to colonise so far inland was because of nomadic warriors. For centuries these stories have portrayed you as the antagonists, but now I see it differently, perhaps we can establish relations, Im sure my superiors with approve,[/i][/quote]
[i] Então vocês são descendentes dos  Gudjukari?[/i]
Wurtalpa diz em reposta ao ouvir do passado colonial, e então rapidamente explica o termo.
[i] Gudjukaris era como nosso povo chamou pessoas que vieram de terras distantes e tinham pele pálida, como vocês mesmo, há muito tempo atrás, mas foram expulsas, foi provavelmente a maior razão para Alkiragunya moderna se formar inclusive, uniu todos clãs de nosso povo atual, e de certa forma perdura até hoje , e uh[/i].
Ele parece que passou algum tempo demais explicando.
[i]Bem, o conselho estaria mais do que grato em estabelecer relações com outros povos, vocês já tem meu voto , gostariam de vir para o acampamento talvez? Há comida e se não for de incômodo, talvez até possamos definir algum nível de relação entre ambos os povos , todo conselho está no Gunya principal agora mesmo, ou vão querer aguardar a permissão de seus superiores?[/i]
[i] So you are descendants of the Gudjukari?[/i]
Wurtalpa says in response to hearing about the colonial past, and then quickly explains the term.
[i] Gudjukaris was what our people called people who came from distant lands and had pale skin, like yourselves, a long time ago, but were expelled, it was probably the biggest reason why modern Alkiragunya was formed in fact, it united all the clans of our current people, and in a way it lasts until today, and uh[/i].
He seems to have spent a little too much time explaining.
[i] Well, the council would be more than happy to establish relations with other peoples, you already have my vote, would you like to come to the camp perhaps? There is food and if it is not too much trouble, perhaps we can even establish some level of relationship between both peoples, the whole council is in the main Gunya right now, or do you want to wait for permission from your superiors?[/i]
